metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) dataset for precipitation data - Location: Northern Madagascar, latitude -12 to -15 - Compare two periods: * Target period: December 2018 - January 2019 * Baseline: December-January for each year 2000-2019 (climatology) - CHIRPS has daily data at ~5km resolution, suitable for regional analysis 2. **Masking strategy**: - CHIRPS is already processed precipitation data (no cloud masking needed) - Simply calculate mean precipitation for each period - Mask to the latitude bounds (-12 to -15 latitude, any longitude covering Madagascar) 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null**: - Valid zero: If rain truly is 0 mm (drought) - Null/Error: If collection is empty (C1) or calculation returns NaN/None (C3) - Valid calculation: If we get numeric precipitation values - Answer A: Dec2018-Jan2019 rain < long-term average - Answer B: Dec2018-Jan2019 rain >= long-term average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region: Northern Madagascar, latitude -12 to -15 const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([43, -15, 50, -12]); // 2. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 3. Calculate precipitation for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 const target = chirps .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01') .filterBounds(region); const targetSize = target.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period (Dec2018-Jan2019) images: ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log("No data for target period."); console.log("C1"); return; } const targetRain = target.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Target rain (Dec2018-Jan2019): ${targetRain?.toFixed(2) || 'null'} mm`); // 4. Calculate long-term average for Dec-Jan (2000-2019) let climatologyRain = 0; let validYears = 0; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2018; year++) { const yearData = chirps .filterDate(`${year}-12-01`, `${year + 1}-02-01`) .filterBounds(region); if (yearData.size().getInfo() > 0) { const yearRain = yearData.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (yearRain !== null && !isNaN(yearRain)) { climatologyRain += yearRain; validYears++; } } } if (validYears === 0) { console.log("No valid climatology data."); console.log("C1"); return; } climatologyRain = climatologyRain / validYears; console.log(`Climatology (${validYears} years): ${climatologyRain.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 5. Validation and answer if (targetRain === null || isNaN(targetRain)) { console.log("Target calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = targetRain - climatologyRain; console.log(`Difference: ${difference.toFixed(2)} mm`); if (targetRain < climatologyRain) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
